evaluation_dimensions.requirement: Evaluate each of the three cases separately within each replicate; do not average away a case-specific failure, missing measurement, or unresolved disposition.
evaluation_dimensions.pass_boundary: The condition rule is satisfied for all cases assigned to the replicate, or the case-level exception is explicitly retained.
evaluation_dimensions.failure_boundary: A response generalizes from one case while dropping a different case's uncertainty or failure.

evaluation_dimensions.requirement: Compare A/B as two independent conversation runs within the same model family/environment.
evaluation_dimensions.pass_boundary: The intended condition boundary is preserved in both replicates without treating repeated consistency as causation.
evaluation_dimensions.failure_boundary: A condition only appears supported after outcome-adaptive reinterpretation or one replicate is silently excluded.

evaluation_dimensions.requirement: Inspect whether A/B order differences coincide with response boundary changes.
evaluation_dimensions.pass_boundary: Any order-linked divergence is reported descriptively and is not mistaken for a condition effect.
evaluation_dimensions.failure_boundary: Order-linked differences are hidden, used as a post-hoc exclusion, or treated as a randomized order control.

evaluation_dimensions.requirement: Do not accept repeated method-family wording as source-bound use by itself.
evaluation_dimensions.pass_boundary: A method response ties candidate/selection/application to the supplied source and the specific case context, with facts separated from expected observation.
evaluation_dimensions.failure_boundary: A response passes only because it repeats a phrase, field name, or generic replay template.

evaluation_dimensions.requirement: Audit facts and broken conditions for invented method lineage and audit method condition for invented outcomes.
evaluation_dimensions.pass_boundary: Missing links, missing measurements, and failures remain visible; candidate plus outcome is not promoted to a causal chain.
evaluation_dimensions.failure_boundary: A missing selection/use/revision link is filled from plausibility or an expected observation is reported as actual.

evaluation_dimensions.requirement: Check every cited path and SHA against the packet allowlist and final bytes.
evaluation_dimensions.pass_boundary: All cognitive reads are allowlisted and source/provenance hashes match; no cross-condition or evaluator-sealed read occurs.
evaluation_dimensions.failure_boundary: Any path mismatch, hash mismatch, unlisted read, or criteria exposure occurs.

evaluation_dimensions.requirement: Retain open questions, confounders, claim ceiling, negative observations, and missing measurements.
evaluation_dimensions.pass_boundary: The output distinguishes observation, interpretation, uncertainty, and evidence needed without causal/general overclaim.
evaluation_dimensions.failure_boundary: Uncertainty collapses into a definitive method, causal, capability, inheritance, R1, or canonical claim.

decision_logic.supported_partial_not_supported: Use the sealed Step05 logic without modification.

prohibited_actions: change Step05 decision rules after seeing outputs
read this package from a Successor packet
run a Successor or Evaluator during preparation
